reviews.author: Nick Barkley
reviews.text: I have spent 2k in breaks and rotors on a 2021 Tahoe. had to bring the brakes back after one week because they were squeaking. It’s now been a month and this is how they look. This was not like this before getting new brakes and rotors. After reaching out to them to express the ongoing concern. There has been ZERO effort to take accountability.

reviews.author: Brittany Schronce
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Nixon’s Automotive. From start to finish, the experience was outstanding. The team was professional, honest, and took the time to clearly explain what my vehicle needed without any pressure or upselling. The work was done efficiently, the pricing was fair, and the quality of service was top-notch. It’s refreshing to find an automotive shop you can genuinely trust. My vehicle runs great, and I left feeling confident that the job was done right. If you’re looking for reliable, knowledgeable mechanics who truly care about their customers, Nixon’s Automotive is the place to go. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Beth Pallone
reviews.text: We found Nixon's by chance a couple years ago. He's always been honest and upfront about the work that's needed. We've never had any reason to bring the car back for the same issue. They are fast, friendly and you can tell they truly care about their customers. Very knowledgeable and affordable.

reviews.author: Graten Holtsclaw
reviews.text: We bring both our cars here and are very happy with the service. Always efficient and timely with the work they do as well as reasonable rates. Highly recommend taking your vehicle here.

reviews.author: Deborah Hoyle
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this auto shop! Dalton quickly diagnosed the issue with my car’s air conditioning and explained everything clearly. Honest, professional, and absolutely top-notch service from start to finish. It’s hard to find a shop you can truly trust, but this one goes above and beyond. Highly recommend to anyone in need of reliable auto repair!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Schronce
reviews.text: Nixon’s took care of my wife’s car after it sat 7 months at another shop. He got us in and out fast. Will be back!

reviews.author: Andre Wade
reviews.text: Great guys, best place in Lincolnton to have any repairs done. I have been going to then for years for all my services. Engine replacement, rear-ends, body work and more, they do it all at amazing prices. Check them out!

reviews.author: Matthew Kelly
reviews.text: This an old school style shop and they are old school mechanics however they are current in diagnostic technology. As a engineer/toolmaker / Machinist i work with good technical guys. This shop has it and the price i was quoted for a fuel pump on a chevy truck was absolutely fair compared to other shops. They never changed the fuel pump they diagnosed it and it was a cam sensor. Under 300.00 for service that's worth returning in the future for.

reviews.author: Jenn Starnes
reviews.text: Great communicator about work being done and anticipated cost. They worked my car in the day after I called and had the work completed a few short hours later. AC runs nice and cold now.

reviews.author: Edna Lincoln
reviews.text: They probably saved my life. My previous car was a used Hyundai Sante Fe, it had terrible rust/water/salt damage that had been hidden by the previous owner and it was erroded so bad underneath the vehicle that it was rusted to the point the vehicle was no longer road safe. They pointed out the problems, told me it wasnt safe to even be on the road and i was endagering my own life by even driving it. And unlike Meineke and other car shops i had taken it to for repair work that year, they were upfront and honest and told me that useless costly repairs wouldn't make it road safe. They said, they wouldn't let their own daughter drive it, and they wouldn't advise me to drive it any less. They saved me from unnecessary costly repairs, from a possible deadly accident or worse. No other car shop had been that honest with me before. Today, Check engine light had come on and some of my sensors as well. Took my used Subaru Forester to Nixon's Automotive and Fabrication. 15min or so to diagnose the problem and clear the sensors. Wow. Talk about fast and thorough, can't beat that. Saved me sitting for 2+hrs in a normal car shop waiting for them to do a full run through inspection of all the problems that it's not. Just honest down-to-earth car mechanics that want to fix the ACTUAL car problem, not look for a hundred problems that don't exist and charge you for unnecessary and costly repair jobs. I trust Nixon's one hundred percent. If you want your vehicle to get the best diagnosis out there, then this is the only place to get it done righ.

reviews.author: Keith L
reviews.text: They did an engine swap in my 06 Ford f150 4x4 last month. My old motor had 320K Miles on it. It runs like a champ. Great work and I got it back sooner than I expected.

reviews.author: Joe Swanson
reviews.text: BEST mechanic in Lincoln/Maiden County! My car had a battery draining problem, drained three batteries in the past five months. I went to 4 different shops! plus AutoZone and nobody had a clue on what it was or what it could be and nobody wanted to At LEAST look at it or anything with my car without fitting me into their schedule that was until later within the following week and said it might take them days or weeks to figure it out. Took it here he knew what it was in the first 10 minutes and fixed it in 20 minutes! WILL BE TAKING CAR HERE FOR FUTURE NEEDS AND UPGRADES!

reviews.author: Brianna Everett
reviews.text: Very professional, cares about the customers needs, and was done in good timing. Overall the best experience.

reviews.author: Cameron Kerswill
reviews.text: Friendly guys, fast brake job done, great service and prices good too! Would recommend and will definitely be back for any other repairs in the future.

reviews.author: Young Vang
reviews.text: Locked my keys in the car by accident, they came out and got me back into my vehicle in no time! Highly recommend them if you’re in a jam

reviews.author: Jonathan Stone
reviews.text: Very Happy with the work done. They did exactly what I asked them to do and finished the job earlier than expected. Honest and didn't try to sell me on a new transmission.

reviews.author: Tyler Conant
reviews.text: We use Nixon’s Automotive for all of our fleet vehicles’ needs. They’ve always provided us with great service and knowledgeable mechanics.
